This Agreement of Sale is made and executed at Visakhapatnam on this the 18th day of September, 2024 BETWEEN:
1. Sri Srinivas Bandaru, S/o late Appa Rao, aged about 51 years, R/o Flat 402, Sai Towers, MVP Colony, Visakhapatnam, for himself and as agent of Sri Ramesh Gorle, S/o late Suryanarayana, R/o Mangamaripeta village (hereinafter called the VENDORS)
AND
M/s. Seabreeze Resorts & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd., a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at 3rd Floor, Dolphin Plaza, Siripuram, Visakhapatnam, represented by its Director Sri Rohan Mehta (hereinafter called the PURCHASER).
WHEREAS the Vendors are the absolute owners and possessors of agricultural land admeasuring Ac. 4.20 cents in Sy. No. 112/2, Mangamaripeta village, Bheemunipatnam mandal, Visakhapatnam district, having purchased the same under registered sale deed Doc. No. 3417/2011 dated 02.03.2011 of SRO Bheemunipatnam, more fully described in the Schedule hereunder.
NOW THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:
1. The total sale consideration is fixed at Rs. 4,20,00,000/- (Rupees Four Crores Twenty Lakhs only) at the rate of Rs. 1,00,00,000/- per acre.
2. The Purchaser has this day paid a sum of Rs. 25,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Lakhs only) by cheque No. 118804 dated 18.09.2024 drawn on HDFC Bank, Siripuram branch, in favour of Sri Srinivas Bandaru, the receipt of which the Vendors hereby acknowledge.
3. The balance of Rs. 3,95,00,000/- shall be paid at the time of registration of the sale deed, within six months from this date, subject to the Vendors producing clear title and obtaining conversion of land use (NALA).
4. The Vendors shall permit the Purchaser to conduct survey and soil tests on the schedule land pending registration. No construction shall be made before registration.
5. If the Vendors fail to execute the sale deed, the Purchaser shall be entitled to enforce specific performance of this agreement through a court of law.
SCHEDULE
All that agricultural land admeasuring Ac. 4.20 cents in Sy. No. 112/2, Mangamaripeta village, Bheemunipatnam mandal. Boundaries: East - Sy. No. 113 (Pydi Appala Raju), West - panchayat road, North - Sy. No. 111, South - beach access road.
Note: Sri Ramesh Gorle to sign on his return from Srikakulam.

Visakhapatnam, 10-01-2016

Letter of understanding between friends

We, Ramesh Gorle and Srinivas Bandaru, jointly own Ac. 4.20 cents in Sy. No. 112/2 Mangamaripeta, bought in 2011. We both own it EQUALLY, 2.10 acres each. Ramesh's father late Suryanarayana garu is buried in the mango grove on the east side and that portion will always be with Ramesh.

Neither of us will sell, mortgage or agree to sell the land or any part of it without the written consent of the other.

We write this so that our children also know.

Sd/- Ramesh Gorle          Sd/- Srinivas Bandaru
